user.title: TownGas — Select your branch
user.description:
Pick the branch that serves your gas meter ({branch_count} branches bundled).

The WeChat OAuth clientId is derived as "{prefix} + branch orgCode (underscores removed)", so this step decides which branch's official account the QR code points to. **Picking the wrong branch makes the API return 10001 ("system upgrading") after login.**

If you already know the clientId, fill it in the second field to override.

auth.title: TownGas — WeChat authorization
auth.description:
Branch: **{branch}**

clientId: `{client_id}`

Scan the QR code below with **WeChat on your phone** (PC browsers are blocked):

{oauth_qr_markdown}

A blank page after scanning is normal — copy the whole URL from the address bar and paste it below.

The account number is read automatically from your WeChat account after authorization.

Auth URL: {oauth_url}

data.default_price: Default gas price (CNY/m³, used when the API omits it)

pick_subs.title: TownGas — Pick your account

manual_subs.title: TownGas — Enter the account manually
manual_subs.description:
Branch: **{branch}**

clientId: `{client_id}`

⚠️ Could not detect the accounts of this login: {account_note}

Enter the subsId (32 chars) and subsCode. The integration validates them against the API before saving, so a wrong value cannot be stored.

Error 10001 ("system upgrading") usually means the **wrong branch** was selected. Go back and re-pick the branch, or delete this entry and add it again.

reauth_confirm.title: TownGas — Re-authorize
reauth_confirm.description:
The stored token is no longer valid. WeChat authorization is required again.

Currently recorded branch: **{current_branch}**

If that is not your branch, pick the right one here ({branch_count} bundled). A wrong branch causes error 10001.

reauth_token.title: TownGas — Paste the new authCode

abort.already_configured: This account is already configured. Delete the existing entry first to switch accounts.

error.client_id_required: Select a branch, or enter a clientId manually.
error.client_id_invalid: This branch did not return a WeChat authorization redirect (clientId not active). Check the branch selection; if it still fails, enter the clientId manually.
error.oauth_url_failed: Failed to fetch the WeChat authorization URL. Check Home Assistant's internet access.
error.exchange_failed: Token exchange failed. Check the authCode (single use; rescan if expired).
error.auth_failed: Authorization failed — no valid token returned.
error.subs_required: subsId and subsCode cannot be empty.
error.subs_mismatch: The selected account does not belong to this login.
error.org_mismatch: TownGas returned 10001 ("system upgrading"): the account does not belong to this login / branch. Go back and confirm the branch (cities with several branches are easy to mix up); if the branch is correct, make sure the account really is under this WeChat login.
error.subs_invalid: Fetching data for this account failed. Check that subsId / subsCode are not swapped or truncated.
error.subs_no_data: The API returned no reading for this account. Check the account number (a newly installed meter may have no reading yet).
